column1: # Columns: scope <TAB> comma-separated allowed child directories <TAB> note
# A scope is a directory path relative to the repository root.
# Every immediate child directory of a scope must be listed here.
# A ? prefix on a token means the directory may be absent in this phase
# An empty file, an empty allowlist or an unknown scope is an error.
# Files are not checked by the allowlist; naming rules apply separately.
